business_summary: Invesco Bond Fund is a close ended fixed income mutual fund launched by Invesco Ltd. The fund is co-managed by Invesco Advisers, Inc, INVESCO Asset Management (Japan) Limited, INVESCO Asset Management Deutschland GmbH, INVESCO Asset Management Limited, Invesco Hong Kong Limited, INVESCO Senior Secured Management, Inc., and Invesco Canada Ltd. It invests in fixed income markets. The fund primarily invests in fixed-rate investment-grade corporate bonds. It benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against the Barclays Baa U.S. Corporate Bond Index. It was formerly known as Invesco Van Kampen Bond Fund. Invesco Bond Fund was formed in 1970 and is domiciled in the United States.
business_summary_ko: Invesco 채권 펀드는 Invesco Ltd.가 출시한 폐쇄형 채권 뮤추얼 펀드입니다. 이 펀드는 Invesco Advisers, Inc., INVESCO Asset Management (Japan) Limited, INVESCO Asset Management Deutschland GmbH, INVESCO Asset Management Limited, Invesco Hong Kong Limited, INVESCO Senior Secured Management, Inc. 및 Invesco Canada Ltd.가 공동 관리합니다. 채권 시장에 투자합니다. 본 펀드는 주로 고정금리 투자등급 회사채에 투자합니다. Barclays Baa U.S. Corporate Bond Index를 기준으로 포트폴리오 성과를 벤치마킹합니다. 이전에는 Invesco Van Kampen Bond Fund로 알려졌습니다. Invesco Bond Fund는 1970년에 설립되었으며 미국에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
